channel.title: Removal Queue Updates
channel.description: Updates for installed Removal Queue plug-ins.

item.title: Removal Queue 0.5.4 Preview
item.description:
Removal Queue 0.5.4 Preview simplifies the Lightroom plug-in menus.
Both File and Library > Plug-in Extras now contain only:
- Start Marking Selected Photos - Process Queue - Show Queue - Check for Updates - Settings
Help, keyboard shortcut setup, Queue Selected Spot, Forget Selected Photos, and Save Diagnostic Report are available under Settings > Tools. Choose a tool and click Open. Stop After Photo remains in the queue window, and Clear Queue and Queue Details remain in Settings.
The existing marking, processing, and show-queue shortcut titles are unchanged. New shortcut setup installs those three commands, while remaining compatible with earlier installation records. Queue Selected Spot no longer has a standalone menu shortcut.
Restart Lightroom after replacing the complete plug-in folder so it loads the new Settings menu script. This remains a preview release with the same native acceptance limits as 0.5.3.
